# GENERATED FILE - CK3 1.20.0.4 native GUI with MTS scrollable tenet grids
on_rite_updated = {
	events = {
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = { mts_selector_only_metadata_update_trigger = yes }
			}

			root = {
				save_scope_as = rite
			}

			if = { # slient it for EC since EC has unique evvent to inform
				limit = {
					exists = scope:changed_tenets_or_doctrines
					OR = {
						NOT = {
							faith = { has_variable = ecumenical_council_ongoing }
						}
						exists = scope:consume_rite_edit_token
					}
				}

				# The message icon slot must never be left unset, hence the fall-through to the rite itself
				if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = added_tenets count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = added_tenets
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = added_doctrines count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = added_doctrines
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = removed_tenets count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = removed_tenets
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { any_in_list = { list = removed_doctrines count >= 1 } }
					every_in_list = {
						list = removed_doctrines
						save_scope_as = rite_change_icon
					}
				}
				else = {
					root = { save_scope_as = rite_change_icon }
				}

				every_player = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							rite = root
							AND = {
								faith = root.faith
								root.faith.main_rite = root
							}
						}
					}
					send_interface_message = {
						type = msg_rite_updated
						title = msg_rite_updated
						left_icon = scope:rite_change_icon

						show_as_tooltip = {
							every_in_list = {
								list = removed_doctrines
								root = { remove_rite_doctrine = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = added_doctrines
								root = { add_rite_doctrine = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = removed_tenets
								root = { remove_rite_tenet = prev }
							}
							every_in_list = {
								list = added_tenets
								root = { add_rite_tenet = prev }
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}

			head_of_rite ?= {
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0004 # Update HoF succession law
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0001 # Temporal rel head setup
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0002 # Spiritual rel head setup
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0011 # Restore Temporal rel head
				trigger_event = faith_creation.0012 # Restore Spiritual rel head
				trigger_event = faith_creation.1100 # Destroy HoF title if no longer valid
			}
		}
	}
}
